azure.automation.job_runtime.note: Process automation job run time. The first 500 minutes a month are free (https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/automation/: 500 minutes free; not for rate plans with a flat discount or a fixed monthly credit), given in the price list as the zero-priced first tier. The page does not say whether the free units are counted per region; billing aggregates usage over every Automation account of the subscription and the meter is regional, so they are counted per region here

azure.automation.nonazure_node.note: State configuration (DSC) node outside Azure; Azure nodes are free. The first 5 nodes a month are free (https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/automation/: 5 nodes free), given in the price list as the zero-priced first tier. The page does not say whether the free units are counted per region; billing aggregates usage over every Automation account of the subscription and the meter is regional, so they are counted per region here
